_README: Public-source country indicators shown as CONTEXT next to a screening hit's jurisdiction. They never change the risk score or the FATF jurisdiction bump (data/jurisdiction-risk.json stays the only scoring input); any scoring use is an MLRO decision. Each indicator carries its publisher, edition, publication date and source URL; values are transcribed from the publisher's own document, never from a commercial country-risk report (KnowYourCountry and the Organized Crime Index restrict redistribution, so they are linked, not copied). `published` is the name as the source prints it; `app` is the matching name in the COUNTRIES baseline in app.js (test/engine_test.py pins every `app` name to that list). Review when a new edition appears: INCSR Vol. II (each March), TIP Report (yearly), EU tax list (each February and October), FATF consolidated ratings (after each plenary). The FATF effectiveness ratings also feed the DRAFT suggested country score in data/country-score-suggested.json (scripts/country-score.mjs), which is shown beside the current score and changes nothing until the MLRO approves.

incsr_major_ml.label: US INCSR major money laundering jurisdiction
incsr_major_ml.publisher: US Department of State, Bureau for International Narcotics and Law Enforcement Affairs
incsr_major_ml.note: Transcribed from Volume II's 'Countries and Jurisdictions' table of contents (pp. 2-5). Its opening entries match the report's own 'Major Money Laundering Jurisdictions in 2024' list as quoted by the US Embassy Tirana copy of the same report; the remaining entries were not cross-checked against that list. The report states that inclusion in Volume II is not an indication that a jurisdiction is not making strong AML efforts. No 2026 edition was found when this file was built.

tip_tier.label: US Trafficking in Persons Report tier
tip_tier.publisher: US Department of State, Office to Monitor and Combat Trafficking in Persons
tip_tier.note: Tier placements list. Only Tier 2 Watch List and Tier 3 are shown as context; Tier 1 and Tier 2 are kept for completeness. 'Special Case' jurisdictions are not transcribed. No 2026 report had been published when this file was built (the State Department's request for information for it is dated 2026-01-14).

eu_tax_noncooperative.label: EU list of non-cooperative jurisdictions for tax purposes (Annex I)
eu_tax_noncooperative.note: Annex I only (10 jurisdictions). The Council's next revision was scheduled for October 2026; re-check after it. Annex II (state of play) is not transcribed.

fatf_effectiveness.label: FATF mutual evaluation: effectiveness ratings (11 Immediate Outcomes)
fatf_effectiveness.edition: Consolidated assessment ratings: 2013 Methodology table (updated 24 August 2026) and 2022 Methodology table (updated 25 September 2026)
fatf_effectiveness.licence: FATF written content and data: CC BY 4.0, commercial use permitted with attribution (https://www.fatf-gafi.org/en/pages/terms-conditions.html, read 2026-10-08). Citation: FATF (2026), Consolidated assessment ratings, https://www.fatf-gafi.org/en/publications/Mutualevaluations/Assessment-ratings.html (accessed 8 October 2026). Change made: only the 11 effectiveness ratings are kept, and high_or_substantial counts the HE and SE ratings among them. This is an adaptation of an original work by the Financial Action Task Force (FATF). The opinions expressed and arguments employed in this adaptation should not be reported as representing the official views of the FATF or of its Members or of its Secretariat.
fatf_effectiveness.note: One row per jurisdiction in FATF's tables (199). Rule: the 2013-methodology summary row (report type containing '+', e.g. 'MER+FUR(s)') or, where there is none, the jurisdiction's single MER; a 2022-methodology MER (5th round, 11 jurisdictions so far) replaces it as the newer assessment. Effectiveness is only re-rated by a new MER or a follow-up assessment (FUAR), so follow-up reports do not change io. io lists IO1..IO11 in order, space-separated: HE high, SE substantial, ME moderate, LE low. Jurisdictions FATF has not rated (most dependent territories, and e.g. Iran and Afghanistan) are absent, not zero.
